comments.content: The path validation here uses `targetPath.startsWith(this.config.getTargetDir())` which is vulnerable to prefix attacks. For example, if the target dir is `/home/user/project`, a path like `/home/user/project-evil/file` would incorrectly pass validation. Use the `isWithinRoot` utility from `../utils/fileUtils.js` instead, which properly handles path separators.

The security check `absoluteFilePath.startsWith(this.config.getTargetDir())` is vulnerable to prefix attacks. A path like `/home/user/project-evil/file` would pass when target dir is `/home/user/project`. Use the `isWithinRoot` utility from `../utils/fileUtils.js` for proper path boundary checking.
